name: Phoenix metro AZ water holes in airborne LiDAR (independent pool detector)

area.boundary: TIGER 2020 Urban Area (TIGERweb ACS2024 layer 88) clipped to 3DEP AZ_MaricopaPinal_1_2020 coverage
area.city_field: Census place (incorporated place, else CDP) containing the tile centre / hole centre; TIGERweb ACS2024 layers 28 + 30
area.reused: tiles fully inside Scottsdale are copied from scottsdale_lidar (same method, same data)

tile_grid: EPSG:32612 1 km, file <tx>_<ty>.json = easting km, northing km
method: Every 3DEP laser point (all EPT levels, no thinning) binned on a 0.5 m UTM 12N grid; a hole is a 4-connected patch of cells with no non-noise return (or one stray return in a gap, or class 9), 8-1500 m2, compact, ringed by returns, inside survey coverage, normal point density around it, not on an Overture roof (eroded 1 m), ringed by ground-level returns. Each hole checked on the newest NAIP year (NDWI/colour test of usa/pools.py, photo registered to the holes per tile). Details: usa/research/lidar_water.md

kinds.community: 150-1500 m2 (community / HOA / hotel pools, small ponds)

labels: water hole, photo shows covered/dark/not water

sources.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program LiDAR, AZ_MaricopaPinal_1_2020 (Entwine Point Tiles on AWS)
USDA NAIP aerial imagery (Microsoft Planetary Computer 'naip')
US Census TIGER 2020 Urban Areas + 2024 Places / CDPs
